label: state-probe-1848
_why: Validate the v4 STATE metric (at_war / civil_war / revolutionary / in_default) against the 1848 revolution wave, which is near-guaranteed. Snapshots are dense through 1846-1853 so a revolutionary tag is caught while it exists - they are temporary. Tag list widened to the European majors most likely to revolt. If every STATE value comes back 0 the metric is broken, not the world at peace.
